sources.title: City of Mercer Island — Simple Residential Projects (OTC)
sources.supports: Non-structural interior remodels are Simple Residential Projects; OTC building reviews currently not available; electronic submittal via Permit Submittal Portal; required forms (application w/ valuation, Single Family Plan Coversheet, Fire Area and Valuation Form, Water Meter Sizing Worksheet if adding fixtures or re-piping >1 bath/kitchen, Site Development worksheet, Owner as Contractor); plan formatting 11x17 single PDF; contractor Mercer Island business license; complex projects routed to standard review.

sources.title: City of Mercer Island — Building Permits: When Are They Required?
sources.supports: MICC 17.14.010 Section 105.1 permit trigger; Section 105.2 exemptions incl. painting, tiling, cabinets, countertops finish work; exemption from permit is not exemption from code; critical-area/flood-hazard exemptions do not apply unless work entirely within or on exterior envelope of existing building; mapping portal.

sources.title: City of Mercer Island — Electrical Permits
sources.supports: Single family electrical permits obtained online at MyBuildingPermit.

sources.title: City of Mercer Island — Single Family Residential Plumbing Permits
sources.supports: Most SFR plumbing permits on MyBuildingPermit; water supply line/backflow for non-licensed via form to epermit.tech@mercerisland.gov; combination permits cover MEP inspections; Permit Counter 206-275-7605.

sources.title: City of Mercer Island — Plumbing Permits
sources.supports: SFR plumbing via MyBuildingPermit; contact 9611 SE 36th St, 206-275-7605, epermit.tech@mercerisland.gov.

sources.title: Regional Construction Tip Sheet 0 — Permits Required (Mercer Island-hosted)
sources.supports: Interior remodels and water heater installation typically require permits; fixture replacements without plumbing line modifications typically not; note tub and shower replacement does require a permit.

sources.title: Washington L&I — City electrical permits and inspections
sources.supports: Mercer Island (9611 SE 36th St, 206-275-7605) listed among cities issuing their own electrical permits.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit
sources.supports: Online portal for Mercer Island SFR electrical and plumbing permits.
